ex.en: Do you know how to fix this bicycle?
ex.zh: 你知道怎么修这辆自行车吗？

ex.en: Consumers need to know how their personal information is collected before they can make informed choices online.
ex.zh: 消费者需要了解个人信息的收集方式，才能在网上作出知情选择。

tip: 过去式knew，过去分词known；通常不用进行时。

ex.en: The dentist checked my teeth and recommended a softer toothbrush.
ex.zh: 牙医检查了我的牙齿，并建议我用更软的牙刷。

ex.en: Regular visits to a dentist can prevent minor dental problems from developing into serious health conditions.
ex.zh: 定期看牙医可以防止小的牙齿问题发展成严重的健康问题。

col: a qualified dentist｜有执业资格的牙医
tip: dentist指牙医；the dentist's可指牙医诊所。

ex.en: Would you like rice or noodles with your vegetables?
ex.zh: 蔬菜配米饭还是面条，你想选哪一种？

ex.en: Governments must improve public transport or face increasing congestion and air pollution in major cities.
ex.zh: 政府必须改善公共交通，否则大城市将面临日益严重的拥堵和空气污染。

tip: 否定句中连接并列项常用or，不用and。

ex.en: These strawberries are sweet enough to eat without sugar.
ex.zh: 这些草莓已经够甜了，不加糖也好吃。

ex.en: Reducing children's consumption of sweet drinks may lower their risk of tooth decay and excessive weight gain.
ex.zh: 减少儿童含糖饮料的摄入，可能降低他们蛀牙和体重过度增长的风险。

tip: 糖果英式常用sweets，美式常用candy。

senses.en: to look closely at something to make sure it is right or safe

ex.en: Please check your schoolbag before you leave home in the morning.
ex.zh: 早上离开家前，请检查一下你的书包。

ex.en: The dentist will check your teeth carefully twice a year to keep them healthy.
ex.zh: 牙医每年会仔细检查你的牙齿两次，以保持牙齿健康。

tip: check表示“仔细检查”，作动词时第三人称单数是checks。

ex.en: She works as a nurse at the local hospital.
ex.zh: 她在当地医院当护士。

ex.en: Building a new hospital in the region would improve access to specialist care for rural communities.
ex.zh: 在该地区新建一家医院将有助于农村居民获得专科医疗服务。

col: be admitted to hospital｜入院治疗
tip: 住院：英式in hospital，美式in the hospital。

ex.en: The nurse gently wrapped a bandage around my wrist.
ex.zh: 护士轻轻地用绷带包住我的手腕。

ex.en: Employing more community nurses could improve access to healthcare for older people living in rural areas.
ex.zh: 增聘社区护士可以改善农村老年人获得医疗服务的机会。

col: nurse someone back to health｜照料某人直至康复
tip: 作动词可直接接人：nurse a patient。

senses.en: to stop fires from burning by using water or special tools

ex.en: Brave firefighters work hard to put out fires and save people.
ex.zh: 勇敢的消防员努力工作，灭火并救人。

ex.en: Firefighters wear heavy protective clothes and use strong water hoses to put out fires.
ex.zh: 消防员穿着厚重的防护服，用强力水带灭火。

col: help put out fires｜帮忙灭火
put out a fire｜扑灭一场火
tip: put out表示“扑灭（火、灯等）”，要注意和put on（穿上）区分。

senses.en: to take care of someone or something and keep them well

ex.en: I help look after my little sister when Mum is cooking.
ex.zh: 妈妈做饭时，我帮忙照顾我的小妹妹。

ex.en: Our class learns how to look after small plants and pets in science lessons.
ex.zh: 我们班在科学课上学习怎样照料小植物和小宠物。

tip: look after表示“照顾”，后面可直接加人或动物，等于take care of。

senses.en: happening two or three times in a period

ex.en: I water the green plants twice or three times a week.
ex.zh: 我每周给绿色植物浇水两次或三次。

ex.en: In healthy living class, we learn to exercise twice or three times every week.
ex.zh: 在健康生活课上，我们学到每周要锻炼两次或三次。

col: twice or three times a week｜每周两三次
twice or three times a day｜每天两三次
tip: 英语中“一次”once、“两次”twice，三次及以上用“基数词 + times”。

senses.en: to repair decayed holes in someone's teeth at a dental clinic

ex.en: Kind dentists can fill holes in teeth to stop the pain.
ex.zh: 和蔼的牙医可以补牙，帮人止痛。

ex.en: When we eat too much candy without brushing, dentists may need to fill holes in teeth.
ex.zh: 如果我们吃太多糖又不刷牙，牙医可能就需要帮忙补牙了。

col: help fill holes in teeth｜帮忙补牙
go to the dentist｜去看牙医
tip: fill意为“填满”，hole是“洞”，连起来就是“把牙齿上的洞填补好”。

senses.en: to take out decayed or hurting teeth from a person's mouth

ex.en: The kind dentist helps the little boy pull bad teeth out.
ex.zh: 善良的牙医帮小男孩把坏牙拔掉。

ex.en: Doctors at the school clinic teach us why dentists sometimes pull bad teeth out.
ex.zh: 学校诊所的医生教我们为什么牙医有时需要拔掉坏牙。

col: have to pull bad teeth out｜不得不拔坏牙
pull bad teeth out gently｜轻轻拔出坏牙
tip: tooth的复数是teeth，pull...out表示把坏牙从口腔里拔出来。

senses.en: a metal musical instrument shaped like three straight sides that rings when hit

ex.en: Amy hits the shiny triangle with a metal stick during music class.
ex.zh: 埃米在音乐课上用金属棒敲击闪亮的三角铁。

ex.en: In our school band, Tim plays the triangle to make bright and clear ringing sounds.
ex.zh: 在我们学校乐队里，蒂姆敲奏三角铁，发出清脆明亮的铃声。

col: a silver triangle｜一个银色三角铁
tip: 表示演奏三角铁乐器时，前面要加定冠词the，用play the triangle。

ex.en: My sister practises the violin after dinner every evening.
ex.zh: 我姐姐每天晚饭后都练习小提琴。

ex.en: Learning the violin can help children develop concentration, although regular lessons may be expensive for some families.
ex.zh: 学习小提琴有助于儿童培养专注力，但定期上课对某些家庭来说可能费用较高。

col: a violin concerto｜小提琴协奏曲
tip: 小提琴手是violinist；拉小提琴常说play the violin。

ex.en: My sister practises the piano after dinner every evening.
ex.zh: 我姐姐每天晚饭后练钢琴。

ex.en: Learning to play the piano can help children develop concentration and express their emotions creatively.
ex.zh: 学习弹钢琴能帮助儿童培养专注力，并创造性地表达情感。

tip: 表示弹钢琴通常说play the piano。

ex.en: My sister plays the guitar beside the window every evening.
ex.zh: 我姐姐每天晚上都在窗边弹吉他。

ex.en: Learning to play the guitar can help students develop patience, coordination, and confidence through regular practice.
ex.zh: 学习弹吉他能帮助学生通过规律练习培养耐心、协调能力和自信。

tip: 表示弹吉他，通常说play the guitar。

senses.en: a traditional Chinese musical instrument with two strings played with a bow

ex.en: My grandfather plays the erhu in the park every morning.
ex.zh: 我爷爷每天早上都在公园里拉二胡。

ex.en: During the Chinese music festival, a young student played a soft song on the erhu.
ex.zh: 在中国音乐节上，一位年轻的学生用二胡演奏了一首轻柔的曲子。

col: listen to the erhu｜听二胡曲
a traditional erhu｜一把传统二胡
tip: 二胡是中国传统拉弦乐器，英文直接音译，演奏时常说play the erhu。

ex.en: She practises the flute by her bedroom window every afternoon.
ex.zh: 她每天下午都在卧室窗边练习长笛。

ex.en: Learning to play the flute can develop concentration and encourage children to participate in musical ensembles.
ex.zh: 学习吹长笛可以培养专注力，并鼓励儿童参加合奏团体。

tip: 英式常称演奏者为flautist，美式常用flutist。

senses.en: a traditional Chinese musical instrument with four strings and a pear-shaped wooden body

ex.en: Lingling is learning to play the pipa after school on Tuesdays.
ex.zh: 玲玲每周二放学后都在学习弹琵琶。

ex.en: The music teacher showed our class how the pipa sounds like falling raindrops.
ex.zh: 音乐老师向我们班展示了琵琶是如何弹出像雨滴落下的声音的。

col: a wooden pipa｜一把木制琵琶
tip: 琵琶直接用拼音拼写，表示弹琵琶时也要加the，即play the pipa。

ex.en: The little boy beat the drum with both hands.
ex.zh: 小男孩用双手敲鼓。

ex.en: Learning to play the drum can help children develop coordination and participate in group performances.
ex.zh: 学习打鼓能帮助儿童培养协调能力，并参与集体表演。

tip: play the drums常指打鼓；drum也可指大圆桶。

ex.en: The woman next door grows beautiful flowers on her balcony.
ex.zh: 隔壁那位女士在阳台上种了漂亮的花。

ex.en: Ensuring that every woman has access to education can improve health and economic opportunities across generations.
ex.zh: 确保每位女性都能接受教育，可以改善几代人的健康状况和经济机会。

tip: 复数women读/ˈwɪmɪn/，注意首音节变化。

ex.en: We enjoyed an outdoor concert in the park yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们在公园欣赏了一场露天音乐会。

ex.en: Free public concerts can make cultural activities more accessible and encourage residents to use shared urban spaces.
ex.zh: 免费公共音乐会能让更多人参与文化活动，并鼓励居民使用城市公共空间。

tip: 去听音乐会用 go to a concert。

ex.en: I think this soup needs a little more salt.
ex.zh: 我觉得这汤需要再加一点盐。

ex.en: Some people think that schools should devote more time to practical skills rather than examination preparation.
ex.zh: 一些人认为，学校应将更多时间用于实用技能，而不是备考。

tip: 过去式、过去分词均为thought；认为时通常不用进行时。

ex.en: That clever child fixed the puzzle before lunch.
ex.zh: 那个聪明的孩子午饭前就解开了这道谜题。

ex.en: Clever design can make small urban apartments feel spacious without increasing their environmental impact.
ex.zh: 巧妙的设计可以让城市小公寓显得宽敞，同时不增加其环境影响。

tip: 比较级cleverer，最高级cleverest。

ex.en: Your idea of growing herbs on the balcony sounds lovely.
ex.zh: 你在阳台上种香草的主意听起来很棒。

ex.en: The idea of free public transport attracts support, but its financial implications require careful consideration.
ex.zh: 免费公共交通这一想法获得了支持，但其财政影响需要慎重考虑。

col: come up with an idea｜想出一个主意
tip: idea是可数名词；“不知道”可说have no idea。

ex.en: She keeps homemade jam in a small glass jar.
ex.zh: 她把自制果酱装在一个小玻璃罐里。

ex.en: Reusing glass jars for food storage can help households reduce their reliance on disposable plastic packaging.
ex.zh: 重复使用玻璃罐储存食品可以帮助家庭减少对一次性塑料包装的依赖。

col: a jar of honey｜一罐蜂蜜
jar with the surroundings｜与周围环境不协调
tip: jar 常指有盖广口罐；a jar of 后接所装物。

senses.en: used as the object of a verb or preposition to refer to plural people or things

ex.en: Those apples look fresh, so let us wash them first.
ex.zh: 那些苹果看起来很新鲜，我们先把它们洗一洗吧。

ex.en: The ducks are swimming in the lake, and children love to watch them.
ex.zh: 鸭子们正在湖里游泳，孩子们很喜欢看着它们。

col: play with them｜和他们一起玩
tip: them是they的宾格形式，通常放在动词或介词后面，可指代复数的人或物。

ex.en: These strawberries smell lovely, so let's buy a basket.
ex.zh: 这些草莓闻起来很香，我们买一篮吧。

ex.en: These findings suggest that regular outdoor activities can improve children's concentration and emotional health.
ex.zh: 这些研究结果表明，经常参加户外活动可以改善儿童的注意力和情绪健康。

col: in these circumstances｜在这些情况下
tip: these是this的复数，后接复数名词。

ex.en: She filled a bucket with water to wash the windows.
ex.zh: 她装了一桶水，准备用来擦窗户。

ex.en: Collecting rainwater in a bucket can help households reduce the amount of drinking water used for gardening.
ex.zh: 用桶收集雨水可以帮助家庭减少园艺活动中的饮用水用量。

tip: 一桶水用a bucket of water，of后接所装物。

ex.en: The soup is bubbling gently in a large pot.
ex.zh: 汤在一口大锅里咕嘟咕嘟地轻轻翻滚。

ex.en: Growing vegetables in pots allows residents with limited outdoor space to produce some of their own food.
ex.zh: 用盆种菜能让户外空间有限的居民自己种出一些食物。

tip: 锅、盆、罐都可用pot；平底煎锅常用pan。

ex.en: The ball hit the fence and bounced towards me.
ex.zh: 球撞上围栏，又朝我弹了过来。

ex.en: Rising energy prices have hit small businesses particularly hard, forcing many owners to reduce their operating hours.
ex.zh: 能源价格上涨对小企业的打击尤其严重，迫使许多经营者缩短营业时间。

col: a big hit｜大受欢迎的事物
tip: 过去式、过去分词仍为hit；现在分词为hitting。

ex.en: The garden looks beautiful after the spring rain.
ex.zh: 春雨过后，花园看起来很美。

ex.en: Protecting beautiful natural landscapes can attract visitors while preserving valuable habitats for future generations.
ex.zh: 保护美丽的自然景观既能吸引游客，又能为后代保留宝贵的栖息地。

tip: 可修饰景色、声音等；比较级用more beautiful。

ex.en: Everyone clapped when the children finished their song.
ex.zh: 孩子们唱完歌时，大家都鼓起掌来。

ex.en: Audiences often clap after live performances to express appreciation for the skill and effort of the artists.
ex.zh: 现场演出结束后，观众常常鼓掌，以表达对艺术家技艺和付出的赞赏。

col: a clap of thunder｜一声霹雳
tip: 过去式clapped；现在分词clapping，双写p。

senses.en: an object, such as a piano, drum, or erhu, used for making music

ex.en: Can you play any musical instrument like the piano or guitar?
ex.zh: 你会演奏钢琴或吉他之类的乐器吗？

ex.en: Every student in grade four chooses a favorite musical instrument for the concert.
ex.zh: 四年级的每位学生都要为音乐会挑选一种喜欢的乐器。

col: play a musical instrument｜演奏一种乐器
learn a musical instrument｜学习一门乐器
tip: musical表示“音乐的”，instrument是可数名词，复数形式要加-s。

senses.en: Traditional Chinese art made by cutting red paper into pretty shapes and patterns.

ex.en: Grandma put a pretty red paper-cut on our living room window.
ex.zh: 奶奶把一张漂亮的红色剪纸贴在了我们客厅的窗户上。

ex.en: In art class, our teacher showed us how to fold paper to make a flower paper-cut.
ex.zh: 在美术课上，老师向我们展示了如何折纸来制作花朵剪纸。

tip: 由paper和cut用连字符组成，作名词指剪纸作品，复数为paper-cuts。

ex.en: We hung a colourful painting above the sofa.
ex.zh: 我们在沙发上方挂了一幅色彩鲜艳的画。

ex.en: Public galleries make important paintings accessible to everyone, regardless of their income or educational background.
ex.zh: 公共美术馆让所有人都能欣赏重要画作，不受收入或教育背景的限制。

tip: 指一幅画时可数；指绘画活动时不可数。

ex.en: The children sat in a circle on the grass.
ex.zh: 孩子们在草地上围坐成一圈。

ex.en: Joining community activities can help older adults expand their social circle and reduce feelings of isolation.
ex.zh: 参加社区活动可以帮助老年人扩大社交圈，减少孤独感。

tip: circle是圆或圆圈；cycle才常指循环或周期。

ex.en: Fold the paper into a triangle before cutting it.
ex.zh: 先把纸折成三角形，再剪。

ex.en: Engineers often use triangles in bridge designs because these shapes provide strength without requiring excessive material.
ex.zh: 工程师常在桥梁设计中采用三角形，因为这种形状无需耗用过多材料就能提供强度。

tip: 英式说right-angled triangle，美式常说right triangle。

ex.en: Fold the paper into a square before cutting it.
ex.zh: 先把纸折成正方形，再剪。

ex.en: Creating a public square can encourage social interaction and provide space for cultural events in crowded cities.
ex.zh: 在拥挤的城市中，建设公共广场可以促进社交互动，并为文化活动提供空间。

tip: 面积用square metres；长度用metres，勿混淆。

ex.en: We watched the stars from our tent beside the lake.
ex.zh: 我们在湖边的帐篷里仰望星空。

ex.en: Light pollution prevents many urban residents from seeing stars, reducing their connection with the natural night sky.
ex.zh: 光污染使许多城市居民看不到星星，削弱了他们与自然夜空的联系。

col: a rising star｜冉冉升起的新星
star in a film｜主演电影
tip: star in表示“主演”；过去式starred，进行式starring。

senses.en: a flat shape with four straight sides, four right angles, and opposite sides equal

ex.en: Please draw a big blue rectangle in the middle of your paper.
ex.zh: 请在你的纸中间画一个大大的蓝色长方形。

ex.en: In math class, we learned that our classroom door and whiteboard each look like a rectangle.
ex.zh: 在数学课上，我们学到教室的门和白板看起来都像一个长方形。

col: draw a rectangle｜画一个长方形
a green rectangle｜一个绿色的矩形
shaped like a rectangle｜呈长方形
tip: rectangle结尾是-angle，和triangle一样都表示角，指有直角的长方形。

ex.en: The kitchen clock stopped while we were making lunch.
ex.zh: 我们做午饭时，厨房的时钟停了。

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements allow employees to work when they are most productive, rather than watching the clock.
ex.zh: 弹性工作安排让员工在效率最高时工作，而不是盯着时钟等下班。

col: watch the clock｜盯着时间等下班
tip: clock通常指钟；戴在手腕上的表叫watch。

ex.en: She cut the biscuits into the shape of stars.
ex.zh: 她把饼干坯切成了星星的形状。

ex.en: Early childhood experiences can shape attitudes towards learning and influence future educational achievement.
ex.zh: 幼年经历可以塑造学习态度，并影响未来的学业成就。

col: stay in shape｜保持良好的身体状态
tip: in shape可指身体状态好，不只表示形状。

senses.en: one of the flat straight lines that form the edge of a shape

ex.en: A square has four straight sides of the exact same length.
ex.zh: 正方形有四条长度完全相同的直边。

ex.en: Look closely at this red triangle and count each side with your finger.
ex.zh: 仔细看这个红色的三角形，用你的手指逐一数出它的每一条边。

col: three equal sides｜三条相等的边
the length of each side｜每条边的长度
tip: 在几何图形中，side表示“边”，例如正方形有four sides（四条边）。

ex.en: We put a small lamp in the corner.
ex.zh: 我们在角落里放了一盏小灯。

ex.en: Shops on street corners can encourage walking by making everyday services more accessible to local residents.
ex.zh: 街角商店让当地居民更方便地获得日常服务，从而鼓励人们步行。

col: around the corner｜在拐角处；即将到来
tip: 室内角落用in the corner；街道拐角常用on或at。

ex.en: I asked the driver where the bus stopped.
ex.zh: 我问司机公交车在哪里停。

ex.en: Schools should ask students for feedback before introducing major changes to classroom teaching methods.
ex.zh: 学校在对课堂教学方法作出重大调整前，应征求学生的反馈。

col: ask someone to do something｜请某人做某事
ask someone over｜邀请某人来家里
tip: ask for接想要的东西；ask someone to do表示请某人做。

ex.en: The tiger rested in the shade beside a pool.
ex.zh: 那只老虎在水池旁的阴凉处休息。

ex.en: Protecting tiger habitats also helps conserve other species that share the same forest ecosystems.
ex.zh: 保护老虎栖息地也有助于保护同一森林生态系统中的其他物种。

tip: 可数名词；一只老虎用a tiger。

ex.en: Please say your name again so I can remember it.
ex.zh: 请再说一遍你的名字，好让我记住。

ex.en: Residents should have a say in planning decisions that directly affect their neighbourhoods and daily lives.
ex.zh: 居民应当对直接影响其社区和日常生活的规划决策拥有发言权。

col: say something to someone｜对某人说某事
have a say in｜对……有发言权
tip: 说某事用say something；告诉某人用tell someone。

ex.en: We spent the whole day building sandcastles on the beach.
ex.zh: 我们一整天都在海滩上堆沙堡。

ex.en: Shorter working days may improve employee wellbeing while allowing parents to spend more time with their children.
ex.zh: 缩短每日工作时间可能改善员工的身心状态，同时让家长有更多时间陪伴孩子。

tip: every day意为每天；everyday是形容词，意为日常的。

ex.en: We watched the stars from our balcony last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚，我们在阳台上看星星。

ex.en: Excessive artificial light at night can disrupt sleep patterns and affect the behaviour of urban wildlife.
ex.zh: 夜间过多的人造光会扰乱睡眠规律，并影响城市野生动物的行为。

col: a good night's sleep｜一夜好眠
tip: 泛指夜间用at night；last night前不加介词。

ex.en: The walk to the lake took us an hour.
ex.zh: 我们走到湖边花了一个小时。

ex.en: Reducing working hours may improve employee wellbeing without necessarily lowering overall productivity in the workplace.
ex.zh: 缩短工作时间可能改善员工的身心健康，而不一定降低工作场所的整体生产率。

tip: h不发音，所以说an hour，而不是a hour。

ex.en: Wait a minute while I find my keys.
ex.zh: 等一下，我找找钥匙。

ex.en: Even a minute of regular classroom discussion can encourage students to reflect on what they have learned.
ex.zh: 即使每次只进行一分钟的常规课堂讨论，也能鼓励学生反思所学内容。

col: at the last minute｜在最后一刻
tip: 会议记录用复数minutes；形容词“微小的”重音在后。

senses.en: a very short unit of time, one sixtieth of a minute

ex.en: There are sixty seconds in one minute on a clock.
ex.zh: 时钟上的一分钟有六十秒。

ex.en: During our science experiment, we used a timer to count every second carefully.
ex.zh: 在科学实验课上，我们用计时器仔细数清了每一秒。

tip: second作名词时意为“秒”，作序数词才表示“第二”，注意区分词义。

ex.en: I put aside a little money every month.
ex.zh: 我每个月都会存下一点钱。

ex.en: Offering employees one additional day off each month could improve wellbeing without significantly reducing overall productivity.
ex.zh: 每月给员工额外一天假期，可以改善他们的身心状态，而不会显著降低整体生产效率。

tip: last、next、every month前通常不加介词。

ex.en: We moved into this flat almost a year ago.
ex.zh: 我们搬进这套公寓快一年了。

ex.en: A gap year can give students valuable work experience before they begin university studies.
ex.zh: 间隔年可以让学生在开始大学学习前获得宝贵的工作经验。

tip: last year等时间短语前不加介词；年龄用years old。

ex.en: We measured the window before buying new curtains.
ex.zh: 我们买新窗帘前量了窗户的尺寸。

ex.en: Governments should introduce effective measures to reduce air pollution without placing excessive costs on low-income households.
ex.zh: 政府应采取有效措施减少空气污染，同时避免让低收入家庭承担过高费用。

col: take measures to do something｜采取措施做某事
a measure of success｜衡量成功的标准
tip: 采取措施用 take measures；测量某物直接接宾语。

ex.en: I raised my hand to ask the teacher a question.
ex.zh: 我举手向老师提了一个问题。

ex.en: Researchers increasingly question whether longer working hours actually improve productivity in modern office environments.
ex.zh: 研究人员越来越质疑，在现代办公环境中，延长工作时间是否真的能提高生产效率。

tip: 动词question可直接接人，表示询问或盘问。

ex.en: We spread a blanket on the ground beneath a tree.
ex.zh: 我们在树下的地面上铺了一条毯子。

ex.en: Planting trees helps the ground retain moisture and reduces the risk of soil erosion.
ex.zh: 植树有助于土地保持水分，并降低水土流失的风险。

tip: 表示理由常用复数grounds；ground也是grind的过去式。

ex.en: I get some exercise by walking to the shops.
ex.zh: 我步行去商店，顺便锻炼一下。

ex.en: Regular exercise can improve mental health and reduce the risk of several common chronic diseases.
ex.zh: 经常运动能够改善心理健康，并降低几种常见慢性病的患病风险。

tip: 泛指运动时不可数；一项练习或一套动作中的动作可数。

senses.en: to prepare yourself or your things for something that is going to happen

ex.en: It is seven o'clock now, so please get ready for school.
ex.zh: 现在七点钟了，请准备去上学吧。

ex.en: Before the science fair starts, all teams get ready by setting up their tables.
ex.zh: 科学展开幕前，所有小组都通过布置展台来做好准备。

col: get ready for school｜准备好去上学
get ready to start｜准备开始
tip: 常见搭配为get ready for+名词（为……做准备）或get ready to+动词。

senses.en: happening together at one exact moment

ex.en: My sister and I always arrive home at the same time.
ex.zh: 我姐姐和我总是同时回到家。

ex.en: In the relay race, two runners from different classes reached the finish line at the same time.
ex.zh: 在接力赛中，来自不同班级的两名选手同时冲过了终点线。

col: arrive at the same time｜同时到达
speak at the same time｜同时说话
happen at the same time｜同时发生
tip: 固定短语中same前一定要有the，不要漏掉，表示“在同一个时间”。

senses.en: a question used to ask someone what the current clock time is

ex.en: "Excuse me, what time is it?" "It is half past three."
ex.zh: “打扰一下，现在几点了？”“现在三点半了。”

ex.en: Before our outdoor nature walk begins, Ben looks at the clock and asks, "What time is it?"
ex.zh: 在我们的户外自然漫步开始前，本看着时钟问道：“现在几点了？”

col: It's eight o'clock.｜现在八点钟了。
tip: 询问时间最常用的句型，回答时常用“It is + 具体时间.”来作答。

ex.en: She poured the warm liquid carefully into a glass.
ex.zh: 她小心地把温热的液体倒进玻璃杯。

ex.en: Scientists analyse liquid samples from rivers to identify pollutants and assess potential risks to public health.
ex.zh: 科学家分析河流中的液体样本，以识别污染物并评估其对公众健康的潜在风险。

tip: liquid作名词指液体；liquid assets指现金或易变现资产。

ex.en: The lake froze solid during the bitterly cold night.
ex.zh: 在那个严寒的夜晚，湖面完全冻住了。

ex.en: Governments need solid evidence before introducing policies that could significantly affect public health and household spending.
ex.zh: 政府在出台可能显著影响公共卫生和家庭开支的政策前，需要可靠的证据。

tip: solid作名词指固体；solid evidence表示可靠证据。

ex.en: We use gas to cook our meals at home.
ex.zh: 我们在家用燃气做饭。

ex.en: Reducing greenhouse gas emissions requires investment in cleaner energy and more efficient public transport systems.
ex.zh: 减少温室气体排放需要投资更清洁的能源和更高效的公共交通系统。

tip: 泛指气体通常不可数；多种气体用gases。

ex.en: She stirred a spoonful of sugar into her tea.
ex.zh: 她往茶里加了一勺糖，搅拌均匀。

ex.en: Reducing sugar consumption can help prevent health problems associated with an unhealthy diet.
ex.zh: 减少糖的摄入有助于预防与不健康饮食有关的健康问题。

tip: 泛指食糖时通常不可数；a spoonful of sugar指一勺糖。

ex.en: Please pass the salt before the soup gets cold.
ex.zh: 趁汤还没凉，请把盐递过来。

ex.en: Reducing salt intake is an effective way to lower the risk of high blood pressure.
ex.zh: 减少盐的摄入量是降低高血压风险的有效方法。

col: a pinch of salt｜一小撮盐
tip: 食盐通常不可数；“一小撮盐”用a pinch of salt。

ex.en: She poured fresh cream over a bowl of strawberries.
ex.zh: 她把新鲜奶油浇在一碗草莓上。

ex.en: Replacing cream with lower-fat ingredients can reduce the energy content of meals without greatly affecting flavour.
ex.zh: 用低脂食材替代奶油，可以降低餐食的热量，而不会明显影响风味。

tip: cream是奶油或乳霜；cheese才是奶酪。

ex.en: The butter melted quickly in the warm pan.
ex.zh: 黄油在温热的平底锅里很快就化了。

ex.en: As global temperatures rise, mountain glaciers melt faster, threatening freshwater supplies for communities downstream.
ex.zh: 随着全球气温上升，山地冰川融化加快，威胁着下游社区的淡水供应。

col: melt someone's heart｜打动某人的心
tip: melt指受热融化；dissolve指溶于液体。

ex.en: Steam rose from the soup as I lifted the lid.
ex.zh: 我揭开盖子时，汤里升起了热气。

ex.en: Some power stations use heat to produce steam, which drives turbines and generates electricity.
ex.zh: 一些发电站利用热量产生蒸汽，推动涡轮机发电。

col: run out of steam｜耗尽精力
tip: steam作名词通常不可数；作动词可表示蒸食物。

senses.en: to make something warm or hot

ex.en: Mom will heat the milk in a small pot for breakfast.
ex.zh: 妈妈会在小锅里把牛奶加热当作早餐。

ex.en: In our science class, we heat water slowly to see small bubbles rise up.
ex.zh: 在科学课上，我们慢慢地给水加热，观察小气泡升起来。

tip: 这里heat作动词表示“加热”，注意字母组合ea发长音/iː/。

ex.en: I felt hungry after our long walk by the river.
ex.zh: 在河边走了很久之后，我觉得饿了。

ex.en: School meal programmes help hungry children concentrate in class and participate more actively in learning.
ex.zh: 学校供餐计划帮助饥饿的孩子集中课堂注意力，更积极地参与学习。

tip: hungry for后接名词，表示渴望某物。

ex.en: We held a small party in the garden yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们在花园里办了一场小聚会。

ex.en: Each political party should explain how its education policies will benefit students from disadvantaged backgrounds.
ex.zh: 每个政党都应说明其教育政策将如何惠及弱势背景的学生。

tip: 合同中的party指当事方，不是聚会或政党。

senses.en: A very cold, sweet frozen food made from milk and sugar.

ex.en: Would you like chocolate or vanilla ice cream after lunch today?
ex.zh: 今天午饭后你想吃巧克力味还是香草味的冰淇淋？

ex.en: During our summer trip to the beach, we bought fresh mango ice cream to cool down.
ex.zh: 暑假去海边游玩时，我们买了新鲜的芒果冰淇淋来解暑。

col: an ice cream cone｜一个甜筒冰淇淋
tip: 指“冰淇淋”这种食物时多为不可数名词；指“一份冰淇淋”时可数。

ex.en: Put the ice cream back in the freezer.
ex.zh: 把冰激凌放回冷冻室。

ex.en: Using a freezer allows households to store seasonal produce longer and reduce food waste.
ex.zh: 使用冷冻柜能让家庭更长时间地储存时令农产品，减少食物浪费。

col: defrost the freezer｜给冷冻柜除霜
tip: freezer用于冷冻；fridge主要用于冷藏。

ex.en: Please close the door before the cat gets out.
ex.zh: 请关上门，别让猫跑出去。

ex.en: Installing wider doors in public buildings can make everyday journeys easier for people who use wheelchairs.
ex.zh: 在公共建筑中安装更宽的门，可以让轮椅使用者的日常出行更方便。

tip: at the door指在门口；answer the door指应声开门。

ex.en: Leave the window open so fresh air can come in.
ex.zh: 让窗户开着，好让新鲜空气进来。

ex.en: Governments should remain open to public feedback when developing policies that affect access to essential services.
ex.zh: 政府制定影响基本服务获取的政策时，应保持开放态度，听取公众反馈。

col: open to the public｜向公众开放
open to suggestions｜愿意听取建议
keep an open mind｜保持开放心态
tip: be open表示开着的状态；open作动词表示打开的动作。

ex.en: This lunch box is made of strong recycled plastic.
ex.zh: 这个午餐盒由结实的再生塑料制成。

ex.en: Reducing single-use plastic packaging could protect marine ecosystems and lower the costs of managing household waste.
ex.zh: 减少一次性塑料包装可以保护海洋生态系统，并降低生活垃圾处理成本。

tip: 表示塑料材料时通常不可数；a plastic指一种塑料。

ex.en: Mix the flour and eggs in a large bowl.
ex.zh: 把面粉和鸡蛋放进大碗里拌匀。

ex.en: Successful neighbourhoods often contain a mix of housing types that serve people with different incomes.
ex.zh: 成功的社区通常包含多种住房类型，以满足不同收入人群的需求。

col: a diverse mix｜多样化的组合
tip: mix A with B指混合；mix A up with B指混淆。

ex.en: Please put your wet umbrella beside the door.
ex.zh: 请把你的湿雨伞放在门旁边。

ex.en: Rising housing costs put considerable pressure on young people who are starting their careers.
ex.zh: 不断上涨的住房成本给刚开始职业生涯的年轻人带来很大压力。

col: put something in place｜落实某项安排
tip: 过去式、过去分词均为put；放置义通常需接地点。

ex.en: Stir the mixture until it becomes smooth and creamy.
ex.zh: 搅拌混合物，直到它变得顺滑绵密。

ex.en: Successful cities offer a mixture of affordable housing, reliable transport, and accessible public spaces.
ex.zh: 成功的城市兼具可负担的住房、可靠的交通和方便使用的公共空间。

tip: a mixture of 后可接物质，也可接情感等抽象事物。

ex.en: He shared a bar of chocolate with his sister.
ex.zh: 他和妹妹分享了一块巧克力。

ex.en: Consumers increasingly expect chocolate producers to ensure fair wages and safe working conditions throughout their supply chains.
ex.zh: 消费者越来越期望巧克力生产商确保整个供应链中的公平工资和安全工作条件。

col: a bar of chocolate｜一块巧克力
a box of chocolates｜一盒巧克力糖
tip: 食材巧克力不可数；单颗巧克力糖可数。

ex.en: Shake the bottle well before pouring juice into your glass.
ex.zh: 把果汁倒进杯子前，先充分摇匀瓶子。

ex.en: Repeated failures in public transport can shake commuters' confidence in the reliability of urban services.
ex.zh: 公共交通反复出现故障，可能动摇通勤者对城市服务可靠性的信心。

tip: 不规则变化：shake—shook—shaken。

ex.en: Freeze the leftover soup and eat it next week.
ex.zh: 把剩下的汤冷冻起来，下周再喝。

ex.en: Governments may freeze public transport fares to reduce financial pressure on households during economic downturns.
ex.zh: 在经济低迷时期，政府可能会冻结公共交通票价，以减轻家庭的经济压力。

tip: 过去式froze，过去分词frozen。

senses.en: used as a friendly way to say yes and agree to a request

ex.en: "Can I borrow your eraser?" "Sure! Here you are."
ex.zh: “我可以借你的橡皮吗？”“当然！给你。”

ex.en: "Would you like to join our reading club?" "Sure! I love reading storybooks."
ex.zh: “你想加入我们的读书俱乐部吗？”“当然！我喜欢读故事书。”

col: Sure, here you go.｜当然，给你。
tip: 用于礼貌并热情地答应别人的请求，注意s在u前发/ʃ/音，不要读成/s/。

senses.en: a kind expression telling someone not to feel anxious or afraid

ex.en: Don't worry! I can help you look for your lost ruler.
ex.zh: 别担心！我可以帮你一起找丢失的尺子。

ex.en: When you make a mistake in math class, our teacher smiles and says, "Don't worry!"
ex.zh: 当你在数学课上出错时，我们老师总是微笑着说：“别担心！”

col: Don't worry, I'll help you.｜别担心，我会帮你的。
It's OK, don't worry!｜没关系，别担心！
tip: 用于安慰别人不要着急或害怕，don't是do not的缩写形式。

senses.en: an expression said when you finish a task or activity

ex.en: "Done!" shouted Leo after he drew the last star on his card.
ex.zh: 利奥在卡片上画完最后一颗星星后喊道：“做好了！”

ex.en: After planting the sunflower seeds and watering the soil carefully, the students cheered, "Done!"
ex.zh: 把向日葵种子种下并仔细给土壤浇完水后，同学们欢呼道：“做好了！”

tip: 表示事情已经做完或完成任务，常在手工、作业完成时兴奋地说出。

ex.en: The polite child held the door open for us.
ex.zh: 那个有礼貌的孩子为我们扶着门。

ex.en: Polite communication in the workplace can reduce misunderstandings and help employees build stronger professional relationships.
ex.zh: 职场中的礼貌沟通可以减少误解，并帮助员工建立更牢固的工作关系。

col: polite to someone｜对某人有礼貌
tip: 对某人有礼貌用be polite to，不用polite with。

senses.en: to do something one after another in order so everyone gets a fair chance

ex.en: Let us take turns playing on the swing at the park.
ex.zh: 我们在公园里轮流玩秋千吧。

ex.en: During the science experiment, students in each group take turns looking through the microscope.
ex.zh: 在科学实验期间，每组的同学轮流通过显微镜观察。

col: take turns to read｜轮流朗读
take turns on the slide｜轮流玩滑梯
tip: turn要用复数turns，后面可接to do或doing表示轮流做某事。

ex.en: Please knock on the door before you come in.
ex.zh: 进来之前请先敲门。

ex.en: Strong winds can knock down trees, causing serious disruption to transport networks in urban areas.
ex.zh: 强风可能刮倒树木，严重扰乱城市地区的交通网络。

col: a loud knock｜响亮的敲击声
tip: 词首k不发音；敲门用knock on或at the door。

ex.en: The ox pulled a wooden cart along the path.
ex.zh: 那头役牛沿着小路拉着一辆木车。

ex.en: Before agricultural machinery became widespread, farmers in many regions relied on oxen to plough their fields.
ex.zh: 农业机械普及之前，许多地区的农民依靠役牛犁地。

col: a pair of oxen｜一对役牛
as strong as an ox｜健壮如牛
tip: 复数是oxen；多指役牛，不等同于未阉割公牛bull。

ex.en: We waited outside until the rain finally stopped.
ex.zh: 我们在外面一直等到雨终于停了。

ex.en: Governments should continue supporting renewable energy until cleaner technologies become affordable for the majority of households.
ex.zh: 政府应持续支持可再生能源，直到大多数家庭都能负担得起更清洁的技术。

col: until further notice｜直至另行通知
tip: until强调持续到某时；by强调不迟于某时。

ex.en: Someone left a blue umbrella beside the front door.
ex.zh: 有人把一把蓝色雨伞落在了前门旁边。

ex.en: Students may feel more confident seeking help when someone they trust is available to discuss their concerns.
ex.zh: 如果有信任的人可以倾听他们的困扰，学生求助时可能会更有信心。

col: someone to talk to｜可以倾诉的人
tip: 作主语时谓语用单数；后文可用they指代。

ex.en: Let's invite our new neighbours over for dinner.
ex.zh: 我们邀请新邻居过来吃晚饭吧。

ex.en: Local councils should invite residents to discuss proposed changes before making decisions about public spaces.
ex.zh: 地方议会在就公共空间作出决定前，应邀请居民讨论拟议的改动。

col: invite someone to dinner｜邀请某人吃晚饭
invite someone to do something｜邀请某人做某事
tip: invite sb to＋活动；invite sb to do＋动作。

ex.en: Your umbrella is behind the door in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 你的伞在厨房的门后面。

ex.en: Students who fall behind at school may benefit from additional support rather than stricter discipline.
ex.zh: 在学校学习落后的学生可能更需要额外的支持，而非更严格的纪律。

tip: behind可作介词或副词；fall behind表示落后。

ex.en: Maybe we can have a picnic if the weather improves.
ex.zh: 如果天气好转，也许我们可以去野餐。

ex.en: Maybe cities could reduce traffic congestion by offering cheaper public transport rather than building more roads.
ex.zh: 也许城市可以通过提供更便宜的公共交通，而非修建更多道路，来缓解交通拥堵。

tip: maybe是副词；may be是情态动词加be。

ex.en: The baby began to cry when her toy fell.
ex.zh: 玩具掉了，宝宝就哭了起来。

ex.en: Young children may cry when separated from their parents, so schools should provide a welcoming environment.
ex.zh: 幼儿与父母分开时可能会哭，因此学校应营造亲切友好的环境。

col: have a good cry｜痛哭一场
tip: 过去式cried；现在分词crying；表示喊叫常用cry out。

ex.en: Our kind neighbour brought us soup when we were ill.
ex.zh: 我们生病时，体贴的邻居给我们送来了汤。

ex.en: Schools should encourage students to be kind to others, helping create a more supportive learning environment.
ex.zh: 学校应鼓励学生善待他人，帮助营造更有支持性的学习环境。

col: be kind to someone｜善待某人
tip: 形容词常接to；种类用a kind of加名词。

ex.en: She stirred a spoonful of honey into her tea.
ex.zh: 她往茶里加了一勺蜂蜜，搅拌均匀。

ex.en: Local honey production can provide rural income while encouraging farmers to protect habitats for bees.
ex.zh: 本地蜂蜜生产能为农村带来收入，同时鼓励农民保护蜜蜂的栖息地。

col: a spoonful of honey｜一勺蜂蜜
a jar of honey｜一罐蜂蜜
tip: 表示蜂蜜时不可数；一罐蜂蜜说a jar of honey。

ex.en: My brother told a joke that made everyone laugh.
ex.zh: 我哥哥讲了个笑话，把大家都逗笑了。

ex.en: Teachers sometimes use jokes to reduce anxiety and create a more relaxed classroom atmosphere.
ex.zh: 教师有时会用笑话缓解焦虑，营造更轻松的课堂氛围。

col: play a joke on someone｜捉弄某人
joke about something｜拿某事开玩笑
tip: 讲笑话用tell a joke，不用say a joke。
